package.name: aimdk_grasp_msgs
package.description: What the AgiBot X2 grasp pipeline and its grasp head exchange when the X2 grasp runs on two hosts (aimdk_grasp.remote_head and aimdk_grasp.grasp_head): captures, scenes, plans and the target watch.
